propositions: The never-read baseline_advanced_at stamp is written in set_baseline but read nowhere in src/, and its per-version rewrites bloat git delta compression.
Deleting baseline_advanced_at cuts marginal packed cost per bindings.json version from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB measured over 40 consecutive revisions.
set_baseline must add a write-when-changed guard that returns early when the filtered baseline is unchanged, so unchanged Jira state produces byte-identical bindings.json and no commit.
A baseline field present-but-null must round-trip as present to preserve the `if k in fields` semantics that outbound_field_diff treats as local-wins.
All three set_baseline callers (reconcile._advance_baselines, inbound-adopt path, seed_baselines_from_snapshot) must be covered so unchanged input is a no-op and changed input persists.
A positive control must confirm the guard does not degenerate into never-write: a baseline value changing from A to B persists B and changes saved bytes.
